title: Who Owns the Bank of England?
hero_object: Official 1946 Bank of England Nationalisation Act & Treasury Share Register
hook: This bank’s owner isn’t a mystery. So why does this claim keep getting shared?
punchline: A famous surname is not an ownership document.
visual_paradigm: British Crown Treasury & Central Bank Registry (Deep Oxford Blue #0A192F, Gilded Gold #F59E0B, St. James Marble #F8FAFC)

scenes.speaker: Alex
scenes.text: This bank’s owner isn’t a mystery. So why does this claim keep getting shared?
scenes.on_screen: WHO OWNS THE BANK OF ENGLAND?

scenes.speaker: Maya
scenes.text: You’ve seen the meme: claims that the Rothschild family privately owns the Bank of England and controls the currency.
scenes.on_screen: THE VIRAL CLAIM: PRIVATE FAMILY OWNERSHIP

scenes.speaker: Alex
scenes.text: Here is the actual law. In nineteen-forty-six, the UK Parliament passed the Bank of England Act, transferring one hundred percent of capital stock to the British Treasury.

scenes.speaker: Maya
scenes.text: It is completely state-owned. Profits go to the public exchequer. The Governor is appointed by the Crown, not a private banking syndicate.

scenes.speaker: Alex
scenes.text: You can debate government interest rate policy all day. That’s legitimate economic debate. But claiming a private dynasty owns the institution is demonstrably false.

scenes.speaker: Maya
scenes.text: Whenever someone connects a famous bank to a secret family, don’t look at red string on a pinboard. Check the statutory share registry.

scenes.speaker: Alex
scenes.text: A famous surname is not an ownership document.
scenes.on_screen: A FAMOUS SURNAME IS NOT AN OWNERSHIP DOCUMENT
scenes.source: Beyond the Myth · Facts, not scapegoats
